subject: Re: Kickoff: cross-dataset label harmonization — May status + relation-direction risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: Linnea's ingestion is done — all three mapping files are queryable in Corpus, and the API stub returns relation triples in under 10 ms. My ADE20k+COCO harmonized training run finished Friday: +1.8 mIoU over training on either dataset alone, which is the validation signal we wanted.

Risk: direction handling. The mappings encode asymmetric relations (a BDD label can be a strict parent of a COCO label), and I found 14 cases where naive symmetric merging silently collapses parent/child into equivalence — "rider" vs "person" being the ugly one. Kaia is re-auditing those rows against the original MSEG-derived annotations; her call is that maybe 5 need manual correction, consistent with how the release itself was built (auto-derive, then hand-fix).

This doesn't move the June sweep, but the query API needs a direction-aware mode before anyone builds on it. Linnea estimates 1 week.

Efe
